section.title: Manage Remote Repositories
section.p: Opens a dialog box where you can add, edit, or delete remote repositories.

section.title: Edit Repository Config File
section.p: Opens the repository configuration file in the main editor.

dlentry.dd: The current working copy repository configuration.
Edit the repository configuration file only if you know which Git settings you need to change.

section.title: Preferences
section.p: Opens the Git Client preferences page.

dlentry.dd: OptionsPreferencesPluginsGit Client, GitSettingsPreferences, and the Ellipsis menu.
Global or project-level Git Client settings.

section.title: Reset All Credentials
section.p: Removes stored credentials so that the Git Client prompts you for new ones when needed.

dlentry.dd: Ellipsis menu and GitSettingsReset all credentials.
Use this action when saved credentials are no longer valid or you need to authenticate with different credentials.
